integrity.earliest_public_source_date_role: Date of motivating reference, not claimed first publication of this finding.
integrity.method: Mathematical proof with independent small-parameter error-ball enumeration and published classical code datum

scientific_limitations: Exact capacity is expressed through classical A_2(ell,3), not a numerical closed form for all ell.
Only single-row single-bit substitution/insertion/deletion in the ordered XOR-sum channel is covered.
The A_2(8,3)=20 upper bound is a classical published result, not established by the finite checker.
Optimal-code section rigidity is necessary, not a classification of every optimum.
title: Exact one-edit sum-channel capacity via binary distance-three codes
